title: Multi-Site health alert runtime activation guard
red: SiteRuntimeStateTests and SiteHealthAlertRuntimeGuardContractTests initially failed because the shared runtime-state helper and acknowledgement guard did not exist.
focusedTests: 60/60 targeted tests passed across runtime state, health alert acknowledgement, health summary, trend, display-state, Browser, Desktop, activation, listener, registry lookup, and reload retry coverage; 0 failed and 0 skipped.
releaseBuild: Release build passed before publish: 0 warnings, 0 errors
implementation: Centralized persisted-versus-active Site comparison in SiteRuntimeState.IsPendingRestart, reused it for Site listing and manual health, and blocked alert acknowledgement with stable code site_runtime_pending_restart plus Thai recovery guidance when the persisted Site is not active in the Gateway runtime.
boundary: This module prevents acknowledgement against an inactive runtime route; it does not automatically activate, mutate, or delete Site configuration. PostgreSQL-backed live outage execution, authenticated visual published-EXE smoke, full VSTest testhost connectivity, CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification remain outside this verification run.
